claims.text: This assessment does not estimate government infrastructure repair costs for Viet Nam or any other country. Its model scope is limited to agriculture, forestry and fishing value added and the conditional transmission to government revenue, so no infrastructure damage or repair-cost input, output or scenario exists in the evidence packet.
Viet Nam mean government revenue shortfall versus the no-event counterfactual for the event year in constant 2025 USD (closest available fiscal metric; not an infrastructure repair cost).
Viet Nam probability of a revenue shortfall for the event year.
Viet Nam positive-part expected shortfall at the severe tail for the event year in constant 2025 USD; per methodology, tail measures apply to the positive-part shortfall while the mean is signed.
Viet Nam mean government revenue shortfall for the follow-on year in constant 2025 USD.
Viet Nam probability of a revenue shortfall for the follow-on year.
Viet Nam positive-part expected shortfall at the severe tail for the follow-on year in constant 2025 USD.

limitations: No infrastructure repair cost estimates exist in this assessment; the reported revenue figures are conditional fiscal-transmission outcomes, not damages or repair budgets.

The estimand is a signed difference in government revenue (revenue without the event minus revenue with the event), conditional on a stated macroeconomic path; it is not a total-economy loss and not a sovereign default probability.
Historical input provenance is incomplete per the manifest; the bundle is marked for inspection only and is not recomputable.
Models are not causally identified; results are conditional associations, and price and exchange-rate responses are not modeled.

Historical supporting crop and fiscal-capture assumptions do not transfer to the primary event pipeline described in EVENT_METHODOLOGY; the earlier generic stress experiment is background research and not the basis of these figures.

Validation scores (Bayesian holdout and ridge-challenger hindcasts) are conditional on realized inputs and do not establish out-of-sample forecast skill; convergence diagnostics alone do not imply predictive skill.

Prose must avoid digits. Numeric claims each with one evidence ID. Metadata claims: assessment date 2026-09-07, forecast issue 2026-08-13 etc.

Submit: title "Viet Nam infrastructure repair costs", claims: interpretation that assessment does not estimate infrastructure repair costs; metadata date claim; VNM 2026 and 2027 revenue loss means and ES95 as the only fiscal metrics. Limitations.
